A_25D.name: Original 25D Baseline
A_25D.description: Exact B3_25D feature set. Used as control to isolate Teacher/loss effects.
A_25D.features: SC5_FEATURES tuple (same as B3 execution commit 5e27d7c)

B_25D_PLUS_GRIPPER_DYNAMICS.name: 25D + Causal Gripper Dynamics
B_25D_PLUS_GRIPPER_DYNAMICS.description: Original 25D plus gripper-specific causal dynamic features computed from step-level history.

delta_gripper_qpos.description: First difference of gripper qpos: qpos[t] - qpos[t-1]

delta2_gripper_qpos.description: Second difference of gripper qpos: delta[t] - delta[t-1]

gripper_command_qpos_deviation.description: Absolute difference between raw close command and observed qpos

close_dwell_duration.description: Number of consecutive steps with gripper closed (time_since_close >= 0). Resets to 0 when gripper opens.

time_since_close_onset.description: Steps since most recent close onset. -1 if never closed in episode.

recent_close_count.description: Number of close_onset events observed in the episode so far.

opening_trend.description: Exponential moving average of delta_qpos with decay 0.9, capturing opening/closing trend.

recent_command_variance.description: Variance of gripper command over last 10 steps.

C_25D_PLUS_EEF_DYNAMICS.name: 25D + Gripper + EEF Dynamics
C_25D_PLUS_EEF_DYNAMICS.description: View B features plus end-effector causal dynamic features.

eef_velocity.description: Euclidean norm of EEF position delta over last step.

eef_acceleration.description: Change in eef_velocity over last step.

eef_vertical_velocity.description: Z-component of EEF position delta (world frame).

eef_stability.description: Exponential moving variance of EEF position over last 20 steps. Low value = stable hold.

eef_displacement_since_close_onset.description: Euclidean distance from EEF position at most recent close onset to current position.

action_consistency.description: Fraction of last 10 gripper actions that are identical.
